description: This file contains end-to-end test functions for plugin management commands in Mattermost, including adding, installing from URL, deleting, and listing plugins, with permission and configuration checks.

methods.name: TestPluginAddCmd
methods.description: Tests adding plugins with various permission and configuration scenarios, including force install and duplicate plugin handling.

methods.name: TestPluginInstallURLCmd
methods.description: Tests installing plugins from URLs, handling permissions, non-existent plugins, and force options.

methods.name: TestPluginDeleteCmd
methods.description: Tests deleting plugins, including successful deletion, unknown plugins, and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestPluginListCmdF
methods.description: Tests listing plugins with different permission states and output formats.
